title: Complete End-to-End Successful Checkout and Download Receipt PDF
steps: Navigate to Cart page with items in cart
Click 'Checkout' button
Enter valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code
Click 'Continue' button
Review items, price breakdown, and total on Overview page
Click 'Finish' button
Verify confirmation message and absence of cart badge
Click 'Generate PDF' button
expectedResult: Order is successfully completed, cart badge is removed, and a PDF document of the order confirmation is downloaded.

title: Submit Checkout Information Form with Required Fields Empty
steps: Navigate to Cart page and click 'Checkout'
Leave First Name, Last Name, and Zip/Postal Code empty
Click 'Continue' button
expectedResult: Validation error message is displayed, user stays on the checkout information page, and process does not proceed.

title: Cancel Checkout from Information Form Page
steps: Navigate to Cart page and click 'Checkout'
Fill in partial or full information in the form
Click 'Cancel' button
expectedResult: User is navigated back to the Cart page, and all original items remain in the cart.

title: Cancel Checkout from Overview Page
steps: Navigate to Cart page and click 'Checkout'
Fill all required fields and click 'Continue'
On the Overview page, click 'Cancel' button
expectedResult: User is navigated back to the previous page/inventory without completing the order, and cart contents are preserved.

title: Verify Price Breakdown and Order Summary Details on Overview Page
steps: Navigate to Cart page containing multiple items
Click 'Checkout', fill valid form fields, and click 'Continue'
Inspect the Overview page for item list, subtotal, tax, and total price
expectedResult: Overview page accurately displays all cart items, correct item subtotal, applicable tax, and calculated total price.

title: Network Interruption While Submitting Order ('Finish' Action)
steps: Proceed through checkout up to the Overview page
Disconnect/interrupt network connection
Click 'Finish' button
Verify system behavior and attempt order status check
expectedResult: Order is not placed due to network loss, an error/offline notice is displayed, and the cart contents remain intact.

title: Network Disconnection and Automatic Restoration During Active Checkout
steps: Start checkout process from Cart page
Disconnect internet connection while filling the form or loading Overview page
Observe application handling network loss
Restore internet connection automatically
Proceed with submitting the form and clicking 'Finish'
expectedResult: After internet connection is restored, the user is allowed to seamlessly continue and complete the checkout process without data loss.
